chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) and a group of my scholars narrated to me from Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah, from Al-Hasan ibn 'Ali Al-Kufi, from Al-'Abbas ibn 'Amir, from Aban, from Al-Husayn ibn 'Atiyyah Abu An-Nab, the seller of Sabur, who said:

I heard Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: Whoever visits the grave of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him), Allah will register for him a Hajj and an 'Umrah – or he said an 'Umrah and a Hajj – and he mentioned the hadith.

key_terms.زِيَارَة: visitation (implied by context of visiting grave)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam Al-Husayn (a.s.) according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) via a chain including Aban ibn Abi Ayyash, highlighting the immense spiritual merit of visiting Imam al-Husayn’s shrine. The Imam specifies that such a visitation grants the combined reward of Hajj and 'Umrah, or vice versa, underscoring the unique status of the Ahl al-Bayt in Shia devotional practice. This hadith serves as a foundational text for the theological importance of Ziyarah as a means of attaining divine forgiveness and reward comparable to major pilgrimage rites.
